title: Canva Craft - Canva ka apna image AI
content:
Canva ne apna khud ka image generation model launch kar diya hai.
And it already ranks number one in two categories.
Is model ka naam hai Canva Craft.
Ise Canva Research ne banaya hai, jo unki in-house AI lab hai.
It is available now to all Canva users in the Dream Lab tab, and to developers through Canva's public API.
Craft images banata hai up to 2K resolution mein, aur thirty se zyada aspect ratios mein.
Matlab reel cover, carousel, poster, YouTube thumbnail, sab ke liye sahi size.
Par asli farak kya hai? Yahi interesting part hai.
Normal image models seedha prompt se pixels banate hain.
Craft pehle ek plan likhta hai. Kaunse elements aayenge, kahan aayenge, kitne bade honge, aur kaunsa text dikhega.
Then a second model renders the image from that plan.
Isliye text zyada readable aata hai aur layout zyada accurate hota hai.
Canva ke hisaab se Craft ne DesignArena pe overall fourth rank se debut kiya.
Aur People and Portraits mein, aur Landscapes and Nature mein, ye number one hai.
These are Canva-reported rankings, so keep that in mind.
Ab aap iska use kaise karo?
Dream Lab kholo, aur prompt mein sirf image mat likho, poora layout likho.
Maan lo aapko ek cafe ka offer poster chahiye. Likho: headline top pe, coffee cup center mein, price neeche bade font mein.
Then use Magic Layers to turn the image into editable layers, so you can change the text later.
Mera take simple hai... Canva ke paas millions of design templates hain, aur unhone isi design data se model train kiya.
When a company owns unique data, it can build its own AI. Ye lesson har startup ke liye hai.
